ucq_rotunda_walk.accept_text: The four great halls of the wheel. Royal in the north-west, Magic north-east, War south-west, Apothecarium south-east. Walk them all.

ucq_dark_ladys_ear.accept_text: The great hall of the Royal Quarter, south-west of this promenade. Stand before the Dark Lady.

ucq_sennarath_scroll.accept_text: Up the shaft into Tirisfal, south through the Rear Guard into Silverpine, and on down the Trunk Road to Raven Hill Cemetery on its west side. Keeper Oswin.
ucq_sennarath_scroll.description:
Loremaster Sennarath. Close the door.

I have tracked the Cult's cipher across half of Lordaeron. Four years of it - farmhouse walls, grave markers, a ledger out of a cult farm, and a line of it in a groundskeeper's pocket that I'm still angry about.

I can read about two thirds.

The missing third is a key, and I've come to believe Keeper Oswin at Raven Hill has it.

Not the whole key. The shape of it - he's been reading the same markings on his own stones for longer than I've been working and he has never once written any of it down, which is either discipline or stubbornness and with Oswin it's both.

This scroll is sealed in grave-wax and it is not leaving this city except in a steady pair of hands.

Up the shaft into Tirisfal, then south through the Rear Guard into Silverpine. Raven Hill Cemetery.

Put it in his hand. And do not read it - not for secrecy. Because the wax only takes one impression and I'll know.

ucq_oswin_reply.accept_text: Back to Loremaster Sennarath in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity - north up the Trunk Road, through Tirisfal, and down the shaft.

ucq_pd_gate.accept_text: Through the iron door behind me and down, into the Outer Cistern of the Plague Depths.

ucq_pd_sump.accept_text: The Plague Depths, through the iron door at the south end of the wheel. The Outer Cistern is the first of it. Plague Spores and Rot Worms. Vials, stoppers on. If you drop one, don't tell me.
ucq_pd_sump.turn_in_text: Green-grey. Warm. Not natural, not remotely. Someone is feeding this on purpose.

ucq_pd_vex.accept_text: Down in the Plague Depths, below the iron door at the south end of the wheel. The Weaving Hall, west of the Mid Conduit.

ucq_pd_notes.accept_text: The Plague Depths, through the iron door at the south end of the wheel. Off the Plague Surgeons in the Lab wing.

ucq_pd_ledger.accept_text: Below the city, in the Plague Depths - the iron door is at the south end of the wheel. The Court of Rot is its north-west wing. The Blighted Courtiers. Ledgers, any condition. I can read through a stain.
ucq_pd_ledger.description:
Sennarath. I've moved from ciphers to accounting, which I'd have found humiliating a year ago.

I know who the conspirators bribed.

Or rather - I know that it is knowable, which is a different and better thing, and here is why.

The Blighted Courtiers of the Throne of Rot keep a ledger of every favour.

Every one. Given, received, owed, settled. It is the single most meticulous document I have ever heard described and it is being kept by things that cannot leave a room.

That is what court does to people. They kept a ledger alive, they kept it after they died, and not one of them has ever thought to stop.

I want copies. Any condition - I can read through a stain and I have had a great deal of practice.

The Court of Rot, north-west wing.

That will do. I'll set them against Wrenfall's lists and we'll see whose names appear on both.
ucq_pd_ledger.turn_in_text: Names, dates, sums. Every one struck through, and every sum still correct. Terrifying and tidy.

ucq_pd_voss.accept_text: The Plague Depths, under the iron door at the south end of the wheel. The Blight Archive is its east wing. Voss is a careful curator. Be more careful.

ucq_pd_vats.accept_text: The Plague Depths, through the iron door at the south end of the wheel. The Vault of Flesh is the east wing. Failed Experiments. Gloves on. Don't think about the faces.
ucq_pd_vats.turn_in_text: Fresh, grey and still trying. The vats have been running longer than anyone told me.

ucq_pd_abomination.accept_text: Back down into the Plague Depths by the iron door, south end of the wheel. The Vault of Flesh, deepest chamber. It is large, loud and wet. Bring a healer.

ucq_pd_zulketh.accept_text: The Plague Heart, the deepest room of the Plague Depths, under the iron door at the south end of the wheel. Everything you've killed so far was his. Finish it.

ucq_pyrewood_hunt.turn_in_text:
Fewer to watch.

The Dark Lady will hear of it - if only because I'll tell her, which is most of how she hears anything.

ucq_tin_bars.turn_in_text:
Bars, and not a cinder wasted.

That's how you light a forge.

It'll be warm tomorrow. It has not been warm tomorrow in a long while.

ucq_iron_bars.description:
Fire's lit, so now we make something that matters.

Rough iron. For the Royal Guard's greaves.

And before you tell me rough iron is poor stuff for a royal anything - it is, and it's what they'll get, and they'll be better off for it.

Good steel on a guard who stands at a gate all year is a waste. It wants maintaining, it wants a smith who knows it, and the moment it's scratched somebody above him decides it reflects badly.

Rough iron you can beat flat with a stone and put back on.

That's the whole philosophy and thirty years hasn't shaken it.

Bars at the forge.

And you can use my good tongs, which I don't offer.

Don't touch the ones on the left. They bite. I'm not going to explain how.
ucq_iron_bars.accept_text: Rough iron bars at the Undercity Forge.

ucq_valdis_relics.turn_in_text:
A ward of twelve strokes, carved by a mason who couldn't count.

Delightful. Genuinely - a flawed ward is a ward somebody built by hand, and a hand can be identified.

ucq_kolven_ledger.turn_in_text:
Pages.

So it isn't one of mine.

Pity. I'd have enjoyed the argument, and I'd have won it.
